meta.source: Measured from photos and a video of the macOS Tahoe login window and lock screen on a Dell U3223QE scaled to 3008×1692. Values are logical points, about ±10%.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Names, status-bar items, responses and PAM messages over the wallpaper.

tokens.name: text-date
tokens.usage: The short date above the clock.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Alert consequence text on alert-material.

tokens.name: text-placeholder
tokens.usage: Prompt placeholder inside the password pill.

tokens.name: text-menu-heading
tokens.usage: Menu section heading on menu-material.

tokens.name: clock-glass
tokens.usage: The large clock time. Slightly blue and translucent, like Tahoe's glass clock.

tokens.name: field-glass
tokens.usage: Password pill fill, drawn over a background blur.

tokens.name: field-border
tokens.usage: Hairline around the password pill.

tokens.name: avatar-top
tokens.usage: Top of the initials avatar gradient.

tokens.name: avatar-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom of the initials avatar gradient.

tokens.name: avatar-ring
tokens.usage: Avatar border.

tokens.name: item-active
tokens.usage: Behind a status-bar item whose menu is open.

tokens.name: menu-material
tokens.usage: Menu fill, drawn over a strong background blur.

tokens.name: menu-border
tokens.usage: Hairline around menus and alerts.

tokens.name: alert-material
tokens.usage: Alert fill, drawn over a strong background blur.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Highlighted menu item and the default alert button. White text on it.

tokens.name: pill-secondary
tokens.usage: Cancel and other non-default alert buttons.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus around buttons and the focused account avatar.

tokens.name: scrim-modal
tokens.usage: Darkening behind an alert. The wallpaper is otherwise never dimmed.

styles.name: type-field
styles.usage: Placeholder and visible responses in the pill.

styles.name: type-message
styles.sample: The account is locked due to 3 failed logins.
styles.usage: PAM prompts and notices around the pill.

styles.name: type-alert-body
styles.sample: Anyone still signed in will lose unsaved work.

tokens.name: menu-padding
tokens.usage: Inset inside menus.

tokens.name: bar-inset-top
tokens.usage: Status bar distance from the top edge.

tokens.name: identity-gap
tokens.usage: Between avatar, name, messages and the pill.

tokens.name: bar-gap
tokens.usage: Between status-bar items.

tokens.name: alert-padding
tokens.usage: Alert side and bottom inset.

tokens.name: account-gap
tokens.usage: Between accounts in an account row.

tokens.name: bar-inset-right
tokens.usage: Status bar distance from the right edge.

tokens.name: identity-bottom
tokens.usage: Password pill distance from the bottom edge.

tokens.name: clock-top
tokens.usage: Date distance from the top edge.

tokens.name: radius-item
tokens.usage: Status-bar item highlight.

tokens.name: radius-menu-item
tokens.usage: Menu item highlight.

tokens.name: radius-field
tokens.usage: Password pill: half its height.

tokens.name: radius-menu
tokens.usage: Menus.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Alert buttons: half their height.

tokens.name: radius-alert
tokens.usage: Alerts.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Avatars and the submit circle.

size.note: Logical points. Measured on the 3008×1692 main display; macOS keeps these constant across display scales.

tokens.name: submit-size
tokens.usage: Outlined arrow circle inside the pill.

tokens.name: field-height
tokens.usage: Password pill height.

tokens.name: bar-height
tokens.usage: Status-bar item height.

tokens.name: item-height
tokens.usage: Menu item height.

tokens.name: pill-height
tokens.usage: Alert button height.

tokens.name: avatar-size
tokens.usage: Avatar diameter.

tokens.name: account-width
tokens.usage: Width of one account in an account row.

tokens.name: field-width
tokens.usage: Password pill width.

tokens.name: menu-width
tokens.usage: Menu width.

tokens.name: alert-width
tokens.usage: Alert width.

tokens.name: message-width
tokens.usage: Widest a PAM message line may grow.
